backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods defined.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report JSON mapping implemented features to source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lookup file providing brief one‑sentence summaries of key frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining earth‑tone OKLCH theme tokens and global element styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React app and includes favicon and metadata for the land‑claim website.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component rendering all site sections by consuming structured content from siteContent.
frontend/src/components/DocumentsSection: Shows a documents list or an empty state using metadata from siteContent.
frontend/src/components/Section.tsx: Reusable wrapper component that provides consistent section layout, heading, and spacing.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with a disclaimer, copyright line, and caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Sticky header with scroll‑aware styling, navigation buttons, and a mobile menu.
frontend/src/content/siteContent.ts: Defines the site’s structured content, including navigation, section text, property details, documents, and contact info.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Provides a React Query hook that creates and refreshes a backend actor based on the user's Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an authentication context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, logout, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future backend-related React Query hooks; currently exports nothing.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and custom earth-tone CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, layout, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Describes project metadata, features, requirements, and image needs for the land-share informational website.
